text:
lisa: Customer ACME-prod started seeing 403s for API requests after this morning's scheduled KMS rotation. Quick logs:
```
2026-03-17T09:22:11Z ERROR unseal: wrapped_key_unwrap_failed key_id=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/old-key-id err="access denied"
2026-03-17T09:22:11Z HTTP 403 POST /v1/secret/data/api-keys
```
Anyone seen this pattern after rotation?
kevin: Did the rotation job do a rewrap of existing secrets or just swap alias -> new key? If alias was re-pointed without rewrapping, Vault may still store wrapped tokens referencing the old key id.
aj: I'm guessing a mismatch: Vault metadata references explicit key_id, but KMS alias now points to new key. If IAM perms don't include the old key for the Vault role, unwrap fails.
maria: Do we have the Vault audit line for the unwrap attempt? vault-bot: [alert] rewrap_error key_id=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/old-key-id principal=vault-service role=vault-unwrapper
lisa: Paste of Vault audit snippet:
```
time="2026-03-17T09:22:11Z" path="/v1/sys/wrapping/unwrap" auth.method="token" auth.client_token="s.XYZ" error="permission denied" details.key_id="arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/old-key-id"
```
kevin: That matches. Two quick checks: 1) does the vault role/instance profile still have kms:Decrypt on the old key id? 2) were secrets rewrapped during rotation? If not, we need to rewrap or grant temporary access.
aj: Workaround: rewrap affected secrets with the new key id so future unwraps use new key. Example command (Vault CLI):
```
# rewrap secret using new key
vault write sys/rewrap rewrap=true key_id=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/new-key-id path=secret/data/api-keys/acme
```
Note: test on staging first.
maria: Another immediate mitigation is to add kms:Decrypt to the Vault EC2/instance role for the old key id for a short window while we rewrap.
sre-oncall: Assigning follow-up: infra to verify key policy, support to identify all affected tenants and scope. tagging ACME incident.
lisa: Quick status — I asked infra to check key policies; trying a redeploy of sidecar to force a fresh fetch of VAULT_WRAPPED_KEY metadata (some pods cache wrapped blob). Will update.
kevin: Heads-up — serverless lambdas that have cached wrapped tokens might still fail until redeployed or until cache TTL expires. We should capture list of services that pulled wrapped blobs and schedule coordinated restarts.
lisa: Redeploying one ACME replica now...
lisa: Partial success — replicated pod fixed, client calls back to normal, but several lambda invocations still 403 in logs.
aj: For lambdas you can either push a new deployment (bump env var), or use a targeted rewrap for their secrets. Also verify KMS key policy: sometimes rotation tools create new key and forget to grant kms:Decrypt to the Vault role on the old key id.
vault-bot: [info] rotation_job completed alias=alias/acme-key old_key=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/old-key-id new_key=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/new-key-id rewrapped=false
maria: Suggest we: 1) grant temporary decrypt on old key to Vault principal, 2) run a batched rewrap for affected paths, 3) remove old-key access once done, 4) add verification step to rotation job to rewrap secrets or schedule cache invalidation.
kevin: I'll open infra ticket to update rotation tool to rewrap by default and to ensure key policy automation. linking ticket  INFRA-6789.
sre-oncall: Support — please gather list of ACME service names and lambda ARNs failing, timeframe, and sample request ids. We'll coordinate a maintenance window for forced restarts.
lisa: Collected: acme-web-1, acme-worker-2, acme-auth-lambda (us-west-2), acme-billing-lambda (us-east-1). Sending to infra.
kevin: Thanks. Temporary fix applied (old-key decrypt allowed) to unblock ACME. Long-term fix tracked in INFRA-6789. :thumbsup:
lisa: Noting postmortem action: add validation that rotation job either (a) rewraps stored wrapped keys, or (b) notifies customers with steps and automatically queues cache invalidation. Marking incident sev2 for now.
